notes.title: 🚂 Multiplayer Update is Here + Xbox Platform News! 🎮
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=q1bVoq1IDm4;full][/previewyoutube]

🚂 Multiplayer Update is Here! 🎮
We’re thrilled to announce that Multiplayer Mode is now live in Iron Trails: Outlaw Pursuit!

In this new update, you can:

Team up with friends to defend convoys and locomotives together.
Take on bandits in co-op missions or compete in challenges.
Experience the thrill of working as a team, managing the train, and strategizing your way to victory.
This is a huge step for Iron Trails, and we’re excited to hear your feedback on the multiplayer experience. Your suggestions and experiences will shape the future of this mode, so let us know what you think!

📣 Calling All Players!
If you love:

Co-op gaming
Action-packed missions
Team-based strategy
…then this update is for YOU!

Whether you're here for the adrenaline of fending off attackers or the joy of managing locomotives with friends, we’ve got something exciting in store for every kind of player.

🎮 Big News: Xbox Release in the Future!
We’re also excited to share that we’ve received the Xbox Developer Kit! This means we’re officially working on bringing Iron Trails to the Xbox platform in the future.

Stay tuned for more updates as we progress toward making this dream a reality.

Thank you for your support—your enthusiasm and feedback drive us to keep improving and expanding the Iron Trails experience.

All aboard! 🚂
The Iron Trails Team

notes.title: Localization Enhancement & Bug Fixes!

Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Keep an eye out for future updates and improvements!

notes.title: 🚂 Major Update: From Low-Poly to Semi-Realistic & New Features! 🚂
notes.notes:
🚂 Major Update: From Low-Poly to Semi-Realistic & New Features! 🚂
Howdy, Iron Trails: Outlaw Pursuit fans!

[previewyoutube=KqeCemEqXaM;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited to share some big changes that are sure to enhance your adventure in the Wild West! After listening to your feedback, we’ve made significant upgrades to the game, transforming both the visuals and gameplay. Check out what’s new in Iron Trails: Outlaw Pursuit:

🎨 Visual Overhaul: Semi-Realistic Transformation
We’ve moved away from the low-poly look and fully embraced a semi-realistic visual style, bringing the world to life with:

Enhanced Textures and Details: The environment, characters, and assets have been redesigned with greater realism, offering an immersive Wild West experience.
Dynamic Lighting and Shadows: Enjoy more atmospheric environments with enhanced lighting and visual effects.
🚗 New Vehicles: Roam Freely Around the World
Explore the Wild West like never before with the addition of vehicles! Here’s what you can expect:

Multiple Vehicle Types: From steam-powered machines to rugged trucks, these new additions let you cover ground faster.
Seamless Exploration: Jump in and explore the open world freely, whether it’s chasing bandits or taking in the stunning scenery.
🤠 Bandits AI: New Combat Challenges
The Wild West just got wilder! Face off against new bandit AI that will keep you on your toes:

More Strategic Gameplay: Adapt to different situations as you encounter bandits in varied locations, adding tension and excitement to your journey.

notes.title: Demo Bugs [Fixed] Patch v1.8.6
notes.notes:
We've addressed some critical issues and added new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

Fixes:

Resolved the bug causing the player to jump out of the moving train.
Improved stability and performance.
Additions:

Introduced waypoints to provide easy guidance towards destinations.
Your feedback has been invaluable in making these improvements. Enjoy the demo and stay tuned for more updates!

Regards
Gloac Games
